name: Lakeville (United States)
description: Yellow field charged with a map of Indiana bearing the dates 1776, 1816 and 1976 between two seals reading PROUD OF OUR PAST and CERTAIN OF OUR FUTURE, the motto BEGINNING…TOMORROW…TODAY! above and LAKEVILLE – 1902 – INDIANA in a green bar below.
history: Lakeville is a town in St. Joseph County, Indiana. The flag carries the dates 1776, 1816 and 1976, marking it as a United States Bicentennial design.

features.role: map of Indiana with the dates 1776, 1816 and 1976
